# HANNCREST

> HANNCREST is an independent software studio building native, private, local-first applications for macOS. Every app is built with Swift & SwiftUI, operates without user accounts or telemetry, requires no recurring subscriptions, and processes data entirely on the user's Mac.

For complete, unabridged documentation of all apps, features, technical architecture, and FAQs, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.hanncrest.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Principles
- **Truly Native**: Written in Swift & SwiftUI for macOS — no Electron, no Chromium, no web wrappers. Light on CPU, memory, and battery.
- **Private by Design**: Zero telemetry, zero analytics, zero external logging. No account creation required.
- **Local-First & Offline**: Metrics, AI inference, file management, and speech transcription run strictly on-device.
- **Honest Pricing**: Generous free tiers and one-time purchases with lifetime access. No subscriptions, ever.

## Applications

### [Vitals](https://www.hanncrest.com/vitals/)
- **Summary**: Lightweight menu-bar system monitor with local-LLM tools, 30-day historical metrics, S.M.A.R.T. disk health, Bluetooth battery tracking, crash watch, and desktop widgets.
- **Platform**: macOS 13.0+ (Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia), Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: Free forever for core monitoring; Pro is a one-time US$9.99 purchase following a 14-day free trial.
- **Support**: https://www.hanncrest.com/vitals/support.html
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.hanncrest.com/vitals/privacy.html

### [Breeze](https://www.hanncrest.com/breeze/)
- **Summary**: Native disk cleaner and Mac maintenance utility. Features Smart Scan, Health Score, deep application uninstaller with leftover cleanup, visual storage map, duplicate finder, and developer junk cleanup.
- **Safety**: Review-first policy. Unselected items remain untouched; deleted files move to Trash rather than instant permanent deletion.
- **Platform**: macOS 13.0+, Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: Core scan and uninstaller free; Breeze Pro is a one-time US$19.99 purchase.
- **Support**: https://www.hanncrest.com/breeze/support.html
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.hanncrest.com/breeze/privacy.html

### [StealthShare](https://www.hanncrest.com/stealthshare/)
- **Summary**: Screen privacy utility for screen sharing. Blurs confidential application windows (Slack, Mail, Messages), hides desktop icons/widgets, applies neutral wallpaper, silences notifications, and auto-arms during video calls.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: Never records, screenshots, or streams display content. Operates exclusively via local overlay window masking.
- **Platform**: macOS 13.0+, Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: 14-day free trial; one-time US$9.99 purchase.
- **Support**: https://www.hanncrest.com/stealthshare/support.html
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.hanncrest.com/stealthshare/privacy.html

### [Aura](https://www.hanncrest.com/aura/)
- **Summary**: Offline AI writing and text rewriting assistant. Select text in any macOS app and press Shift-Command-P (⇧⌘P) to proofread, clarify, shorten, or reword text in place.
- **Engine**: Runs 100% on-device using Apple Intelligence, local LLMs, or embedded neural models. Zero network transmission.
- **Platform**: macOS 13.0+, Apple Silicon recommended for on-device models.
- **Pricing**: One-time US$24.99 purchase.
- **Support**: https://www.hanncrest.com/aura/support.html
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.hanncrest.com/aura/privacy.html

### [WhisperType](https://www.hanncrest.com/whispertype/)
- **Summary**: On-device voice dictation for macOS powered by OpenAI Whisper running on the Apple Neural Engine. Press Option-Space (⌥Space) to transcribe speech into any focused text field.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: Operates completely offline after initial model download. Audio is never saved to disk or uploaded.
- **Platform**: macOS 13.0+, Apple Silicon & Intel.
- **Pricing**: One-time US$19.99 purchase.
- **Support**: https://www.hanncrest.com/whispertype/support.html
- **Privacy Policy**: https://www.hanncrest.com/whispertype/privacy.html
